messages:
Kai: heads up — seeing sporadic OOMs on xlarge FFN after we flipped cublasLt as default in canary
Kai: symptoms: sudden workspace spike at FFN launch, evict/reclaim churn, some KV cache evictions in same timeframe
Sam: timeline? which commit/flag rolled out?
Kai: rolled runtime:use_cublaslt_ffn=true in canary yesterday 02:15 UTC
Kai: repro on canary pods consistently with batch=16, seq=2048, model=gpt-like-16b
Maria: can you paste nvprof / nsight trace snippet? curious which kernel requests the extra bytes
Kai: log snippet:\n\n```\n[2026-03-17T02:18:07Z] ffn_launch: selected=cublasLt_gemm_ex workspace_req=1.9GB\n[2026-03-17T02:18:07Z] attn_launch: selected=flashattn workspace_req=512MB\n[2026-03-17T02:18:07Z] slab_allocator: reserve=3.2GB used=2.9GB highwater=3.0GB\n[2026-03-17T02:18:08Z] kv_cache: evict_count=4 evicted_bytes=480MB\n[2026-03-17T02:18:08Z] OOM: tried fallback=cublasLt->triton pool_reclaim=failed\n```\n\nKai: cublasLt is asking for a larger workspace than our old triton path for some dims
Anita: interesting — cublasLt sometimes requests temp workspace scaled with K or when using split-k heuristics
Anita: if workspace budget isn't sized per-kernel + per-stream we get global overcommit
Sam: does slab allocator allow per-kernel reservation? we assume a single global reserve for kernels
Kai: right now allocator has: global_dynamic_reserve + per-request transient 128MB fast path
Kai: on these traces we hit global_dynamic_reserve but reclaim loop couldn't free KV fast enough
Maria: KV cache eviction during active decoding is bad — causes re-load latency spikes
Maria: maybe workspace fragmentation causing small free chunks even though total free >= request
Anita: yes fragmentation. cublasLt prefers contiguous pages for workspace which the slab splits up
Kai: repro command for me:\n\n```\n./run_infer.sh --model gpt16b --batch 16 --seq 2048 --kernel cublaslt --profile /tmp/trace.nv\n```\n\nSam: suggestion: add a "kernel_workspace_hint" to kernel selector that returns (min_slab_units, contiguous_needed)
Sam: allocator could honor contiguous_needed by trying to coalesce or fallback earlier
Anita: also add a transient buffer reuse path: reuse scratch buffers from recent finished FFN ops before expanding slab
Kai: initial patch idea:\n\n```\nruntime:\n  ffn_kernel_selector: adaptive\n  kernel_workspace_hints:\n    cublaslt:\n      prefer_contiguous: true\n      reserve_units: 24\n    triton:\n      prefer_contiguous: false\n      reserve_units: 12\n  allocator:\n    contiguous_coalesce: true\n    transient_reuse_window_ms: 250\n```\n\nMaria: we should also emit metrics: workspace_highwater_bytes, contiguous_failure_count, kernel_fallback_count
Sam: good call. rollout plan:
Sam: 1) add metrics + tracing for workspace alloc/free
Sam: 2) implement kernel_workspace_hint + allocator coalesce in canary
Sam: 3) enable adaptive selector (cublaslt only if hint fits) on 5% traffic
Sam: 4) watch highwater & fallback_count for 24h, expand to 25% if stable
Anita: fallback policy: on OOM try (1) coalesce, (2) transient reuse, (3) fallback to triton, (4) degrade batch size
Kai: one more gotcha: FlashAttention allocates small KV buffers during attn which can interleave with cublasLt request timing
Kai: propose a cheap scheduling heuristic: when upcoming op sequence is [ATTN, FFN] and FFN hint prefers contiguous, pre-reserve contiguous chunk at ATTStart
Maria: OK but pre-reserving hurts throughput for other concurrent requests — only do for single-tenant/dedicated runs or high-priority requests
Sam: we can gate it behind request.weighted_priority > 0.8 or tenant_mode == dedicated
Anita: quick perf numbers from local repro (before patch):\n\n- triton-ffn: avg_latency=9.2ms per FFN, workspace=1.1GB\n- cublasLt-ffn: avg_latency=8.4ms per FFN, workspace=1.9GB\n- end-to-end decode latency (seq=2048,b=16): triton=1.8s, cublaslt=1.65s but OOMs in ~1/120 runs\n\nAnita: after coalesce + transient reuse in my branch: cublaslt runs stable, highwater down to 2.1GB, no OOMs in 1k runs
Kai: nice. can you share branch/PR?
Anita: PR #2489 — implements kernel_workspace_hint + allocator coalesce + metrics
Kai: will test on canary tonight, I'll flip runtime.use_adaptive_ffn_selector=true for 5% and collect metrics
Maria: include debug flags to log allocation map on failure: allocator.dump_map_on_oom=true
Sam: also add automatic fallback rule to lower batch by half on repeated OOMs: oom_backoff.max_retries=3
Kai: thanks — let's try to avoid a big rollback. I'll post canary dashboard link once metrics flow
infra-bot: deploy canary runtime v0.39.2 to cluster inference-canary-3 at 2026-03-17T22:40:12Z :rocket:
Kai: deployed. starting traffic shift to 5% now
Maria: watching logs and KV eviction metric
Sam: ping if you need quick rollback command (@infra-bot can help)
Kai: will do, thx everyone :thumbsup:
